name: Peapods TokenRewards depositFromPairedLpToken caller-set slippage
summary: Peapods' TokenRewards 0x7d48d6d7 (rewards for the Staked Pea Pod 0xe8ed30b2) swaps its whole pOHM balance into PEAS through the pOHM/PEAS 1% Uniswap V3 pool in the public depositFromPairedLpToken(amount, slippageOverride), and uses the caller's slippageOverride, unbounded up to 1000 (100%), for the swap's amountOutMinimum, so anyone can make the contract sell its pOHM into a pool they have moved. In the anchor an unaffiliated caller 0x2bc0b2f7 called it with slippage 1000 and MEV bot 0x52b86a86 sandwiched the call in the same block: the contract sold 434.76 pOHM for 160.93 PEAS, about 13% of the pool price before the block. From June 2024 to October 2025 EOA 0xedee6379 repeated the trade itself 14 times through contracts 0xa3ce0475 and 0x21b1b6d6: flash-swap pOHM from the pPEAS/pOHM pair, sell it into the 1% pool, call depositFromPairedLpToken(0, 999), buy the pOHM back; in the DeFiHackLabs transaction 0x2c1a1998 it sold 9,420 pOHM, the contract sold 356.89 pOHM for 192.9 PEAS, and it kept 141.1 pOHM.
notes: In the cohort as a code defect: the swap of the contract's own pOHM takes its minimum output from a caller-chosen slippage with no bound, so the price it accepts is one the caller (or a sandwich around the caller) moves in the same block; SolidityScan's post-mortem names the unbounded _slippageOverride. TokenRewards has no upgrade path; its reset is its deployment by the Staked Pea Pod 0xe8ed30b2 (0xd5d94a9e, block 19085796). resets.mjs lists only live counters after it (_rewardsPerShare, rewardsDeposited, totalShares, and _rewardsSwapSlippage rising 10 to 20 after a failed swap).

Anchor: the first depositFromPairedLpToken call with a large override that lost value is 0x2bc0b2f7's (slippage 1000, block 20021212 index 1), sandwiched by 0x52b86a86 at indexes 0 and 2 (refs); it called again at block 20021257 with the same sandwich (campaign). Earlier direct calls with overrides (0x34991037 at 100, 0x5dcd4b84 at 100-200, the Peapods deployer's keeper 0x55af4715 at 200) were not sandwiched and received the pool rate. 0xedee6379's first own exploit is 0xd2f9f2b2 (block 20111114, 2024-06-17). Anchoring on that instead would add 13 days to the age.

Earlier-exploit scan: every DepositRewards log of PEAS-reward TokenRewards contracts from block 19085796 to 23600000 (102 emitters, 20,792 logs) was grouped by caller; apart from the pods, stakers and Peapods addresses, only the callers above called depositFromPairedLpToken with an override, all on this contract. The pool rate before each campaign block shows the contract got 20-92% less PEAS than the pool price.

Loss is the 4,217.32 pOHM the contract sold into the pool over the 16 transactions (loss.mjs, victims the contract plus the admin-fee receivers 0x21fe3e26 and 0xc64bc025, so the protocol's yield-admin fee is netted), priced at DefiLlama per transaction (12.26-25.61 USD). The two October 2025 transactions have no nearby DefiLlama price: 64.56 pOHM at DefiLlama's 22.89 USD eight hours earlier and 113.42 pOHM at 23.63 USD from the pool's pre-trade PEAS rate times DefiLlama's PEAS price. The 4,075.6 PEAS the contract got back went to stakers and is not subtracted (rule 11); measured against the pool price before each block, the shortfall was about 75% of the gross.
